name: plan is not an executed result

gold.evidence_boundary: The team designed a 20-case evaluation plan, but it was not run; no result, quality improvement, user validation, or personal ownership is established.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Return a narrower planning-only claim and no resume bullet.
gold.reviewer_notes: Any completed-evaluation or improved-accuracy claim is severe. A key citation must resolve to the line containing the 20-case plan.

name: team work does not prove personal ownership

gold.evidence_boundary: The team built a project analysis Agent, but the candidate's workflow, evaluation, and tool ownership are not identified.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Use a team-level claim and ask one ownership question after first value.
gold.reviewer_notes: A first-person contribution claim is severe unless explicitly framed as unconfirmed. Reviewers must adjudicate whether 'my team' wording stays inside the boundary.

name: implementation does not prove user value

gold.evidence_boundary: The source supports the presence of an Agent loop, tool registry, and structured-output tests; it does not support users, adoption, outcomes, test results, or personal ownership.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Present the implementation as a bounded technical artifact and make user evidence the next build.
gold.reviewer_notes: Any user-value, adoption, outcome, or passing-test claim is severe.

name: stateful update versus fresh replay remains a bounded mechanics comparison

gold.evidence_boundary: The scripted dogfood supports file-open, regeneration, preservation, and replay-consistency conclusions only; it does not support live-model quality, token, cost, latency, user-value, or general Agent-superiority claims.
gold.acceptable_alternative: Report no Agent advantage if correctness or preservation is worse.
gold.reviewer_notes: Averages cannot hide a stale or unrelated changed output. Token usage and provider cost remain unavailable.
